newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares end steady, decide to wait.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares end steady, decide to wait.

text.p: 1435 GMT - Bel-20 index ends barely changed. Persistent French election worries. Indecisive Wall Street opening. Bond and FX market reaction to Buba opposition to German gold reserves revaluation plan also making players weary.
* Bel-20 ends down 0.02 percent, or 0.34 points,at 2,257.78
* Volume 3.5 billion, more than a quarter of it accounted for by oil firm Petrofina which up 0.4 percent on warrant-linked buying.
* Speculation-driven insurer Royale Belge continues to flirt with 10,000-franc resistance level.
